# Vendored QR encoder

- **Name:** qrcode-generator
- **Version:** 1.4.4
- **License:** MIT
- **Source:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator (upstream repository: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator)

`qrcode-generator.js` is the browser-compatible upstream distribution, vendored
so the moderator lobby makes no runtime third-party network requests. The
upstream header contains the copyright and MIT license notice.
